# Single-end, Illumina HiSeq 2500, ~25-30M reads/run. One shared input control.
# Where a mark has multiple replicates in the source (CTCF, Rad21, HDAC1), rep1 is used here;
# alternates are listed in the notes column for anyone who wants to swap or pool them.
# mark is the exact name expected in cellmark_template.tab / ChromHMM's output (matches the
# original lab's cellmark.tab so downstream state interpretation stays comparable).
